decisions.outcome: the_quartermaster reported rice reserves at 75 days. No change to current ration allocation. Next review day 50.
the_general proposed daily perimeter patrol plus one long-range expedition per week. Approved. the_cop to lead perimeter, the_hunter to lead expeditions.
the_radio_host proposed twice-daily broadcasts at 0600 and 1800. the_general approved with content review for security-sensitive information. the_therapist suggested a community request segment.
decisions.vote: 5_for_2_abstain (the_electrician and the_architect abstained citing no opinion on media)

action_items: the_quartermaster: ration review day 50
the_general: finalise patrol roster by day 40
the_radio_host: first broadcast day 38 at 1800
notes: First formal council meeting. the_general established the council as the governing body. Membership: 7 permanent seats. Decisions by majority. the_general has veto on security matters only.

decisions.outcome: the_general proposed a 7-day quarantine for all new arrivals. Medical screening by the_surgeon. Security assessment by the_general. the_therapist to conduct psychological evaluation. Council approved unanimously.
the_electrician reported the water pump impeller seal failure. Repaired with improvised gasket. the_plumber has fabricated spare seals. No further action required.
the_surgeon reported antibiotics at zero. Painkillers at 30 doses. Bandages at 200 units. the_quartermaster to prioritise medical supply recovery on next expedition.

action_items: the_general: draft new arrival intake protocol
the_surgeon: medical supply priority list for expeditions
the_plumber: quarterly seal replacement schedule
notes: the_therapist raised the question of what happens if a new arrival is refused. the_general said the bunker cannot afford to turn away useful people but also cannot afford to accept security risks. The council did not resolve this tension.

decisions.outcome: the_therapist formally objected to the Kilo-1 refusal on humanitarian grounds. the_general defended the decision on resource grounds. The council voted to uphold the refusal policy but allocated one emergency ration pack to leave at the bunker entrance for future refused applicants. Vote: 4_for (uphold with ration), 2_against (the_therapist and the_priest wanted to reverse the refusal), 1_abstain.

the_botanist (invited for this item) proposed doubling greenhouse capacity using salvaged glass from surface expeditions. the_architect confirmed structural feasibility. the_electrician confirmed grow light capacity for 50 percent expansion. Approved.

the_electrician reported fuel reserves at 40 days. Consumption rate stable. the_quartermaster proposed fuel rationing to extend to 50 days. the_general opposed, saying fuel rationing would reduce generator runtime and affect the water pump. Status quo maintained.

action_items: the_quartermaster: place emergency ration pack at bunker entrance
the_botanist: greenhouse expansion plan by day 55
the_electrician: fuel consumption optimisation study
notes: The Kilo-1 debate was the most contentious council meeting to date. the_therapist and the_general are not speaking outside of council sessions. the_priest offered pastoral support to both. The emergency ration pack compromise was the_chemist idea.

decisions.outcome: the_surgeon reported 7 dysentery cases. Source identified as contaminated water from a pipe cross-connection. the_plumber has isolated and repaired the cross-connection. the_quartermaster ordered full water system flush and re-test. Kitchen quarantine until water quality confirmed.

the_general proposed a formal court for dispute resolution and rule enforcement. the_therapist proposed mediation as the first step before court. Compromise: the_therapist mediates interpersonal disputes; the_general adjudicates security and resource violations. Court sessions weekly.

the_quartermaster proposed a formal internal barter recording system. All trades to be logged with the_quartermaster for inventory tracking. No currency. Pure barter with quartermaster oversight. Approved.

action_items: the_plumber: water system flush complete by day 53
the_general: court protocol document by day 55
the_quartermaster: barter recording system operational by day 54
notes: The dysentery outbreak was the first public health crisis. The response was swift and effective. the_surgeon credit to the_plumber for rapid identification of the cross-connection. The court establishment fills a governance gap that has been growing since day 1.

decisions.outcome: the_general reported two cases adjudicated: unauthorised medical bay access (reprimand plus kitchen duty) and ration dispute (mediated by the_therapist, both parties accepted terms). the_therapist reported three additional mediations completed. Court and mediation are functioning.

the_hazmat_tech (invited) reported quarterly average 0.9 uSv/h bunker internal, 35 uSv/h surface. Trend is slowly declining. the_meteorologist projects safe surface work (under 50 uSv/h with PPE) for the next 6 months.

the_teacher (invited) proposed a formal education programme for the 6 children in the bunker. Reading, mathematics, and survival skills. the_quartermaster allocated paper and charcoal pencils from inventory. Approved.

action_items: the_general: court schedule weekly on day 72
the_hazmat_tech: quarterly radiation report
the_teacher: education programme operational by day 60
notes: The council is settling into a rhythm. Formal agenda, recorded decisions, action items. the_general says this is how governance works in a functioning society. the_therapist says it is also how people feel heard.

decisions.outcome: the_general reported that Delta-1, the Salt Freeholder emissary, is expected day 65. the_general proposed a controlled introduction: Delta-1 to be met at the airlock, escorted to the meeting room, and not given unsupervised access to the bunker. the_therapist objected to the hostile framing. Compromise: Delta-1 to be treated as a guest but the_general will accompany at all times.

the_electrician reported the Variac bypass is holding. Voltage stable at 220V plus/minus 2V. Fuel consumption down 8 percent. The bypass has extended fuel reserves from 40 to 45 days. the_quartermaster is pleased.

the_priest proposed a memorial service for day 95, marking 95 days since the event. the_council approved. the_radio_host will broadcast the service. the_chef will prepare a special meal. the_undertaker will read the names of the dead.

action_items: the_general: Delta-1 reception protocol by day 64
the_electrician: Variac bypass performance report day 70
the_priest: anniversary service plan by day 85
notes: Delta-1 is the first external visitor. The council is divided between openness and security. the_general default is containment; the_therapist default is trust. The compromise satisfies neither fully but both can live with it.

decisions.outcome: Delta-1 visited day 65. the_general reported the visit was productive. Delta-1 proposed salt-for-goods trade: 2kg salt per 1kg dried goods. the_quartermaster counter-proposed 2kg salt per 1kg smoked fish or dried mushrooms. Delta-1 accepted provisionally. Final terms to be confirmed by the_Freeholder.

the_quartermaster presented the trade terms. Salt is the highest-priority import for the bunker. the_chef and the_chemist both confirmed salt is critical for food preservation and chemical processes. the_quartermaster to prepare first trade shipment: 10kg dried mushrooms and 5kg dried herbs for 30kg salt.

the_general reported the generator sabotage investigation is ongoing. No suspects identified. the_cop has increased lock changes. the_general proposed a bunker-wide security audit. the_architect to assess physical vulnerabilities. the_electrician to assess electronic access points.

action_items: the_quartermaster: prepare first salt trade shipment by day 75
the_architect: physical security audit by day 75
the_electrician: electronic access audit by day 75
the_general: security review report day 80
notes: Delta-1 impressed the council. the_therapist said the emissary was genuine. the_general said the emissary was professional. Both are true. The salt trade is the first external economic relationship. It changes the bunker from isolated to connected.

decisions.outcome: the_general reported four cases: two mediations (the_therapist) and two adjudications. All resolved. the_therapist proposed that mediation outcomes be confidential unless both parties agree to disclosure. Approved.

the_architect and the_electrician presented joint audit findings. Three physical vulnerabilities identified: eastern periscope blind spot, ventilation shaft access point in corridor D, and the drainage sump external connection. the_architect has remediation plans for all three. Estimated completion: day 85.

the_general proposed the seed vault expedition for day 61 window. the_hazmat_tech to lead radiation safety. the_courier to lead navigation. the_hunter to provide security. the_quartermaster to prepare extraction equipment.

action_items: the_architect: security remediation by day 85
the_general: seed vault expedition briefing day 59
the_quartermaster: extraction equipment ready by day 60
notes: The security audit was thorough. The eastern blind spot is the highest priority. the_architect says a periscope extension can cover it. The drainage sump connection is the most concerning because it is an unmonitored physical access point.

decisions.outcome: the_courier reported 17 total seed ampoules recovered across two missions. the_botanist reports 12 viable, 3 uncertain, 2 failed. the_quartermaster says the viable seeds could increase bunker food production by 40 percent within one growing season. the_council expressed gratitude for the expedition team and noted the loss of the_hazmat_tech on the second mission.

the_quartermaster reported the first salt trade completed. 15kg dried goods exchanged for 30kg salt. the_chef says the salt quality is high. the_chemist is already using it for preservation. Monthly trade schedule established.

the_therapist reported 18 active therapy cases. 12 resolved or improving. 3 stable. 3 requiring increased attention. the_therapist requested an additional counselling space. the_architect identified the laundry alcove annex as available after the_widow relocation. Approved.

action_items: the_botanist: seed planting schedule by day 80
the_quartermaster: monthly salt trade shipment by day 85
the_architect: counselling space conversion by day 82
notes: The seed vault recovery is the most significant material gain since the bunker was sealed. 17 ampoules represent genetic diversity that the greenhouse desperately needs. The_hazmat_tech death was acknowledged with a moment of silence.

decisions.outcome: the_general reported the Juliet-1 settlement survey. 3 of 12 settlements assessed: 1 abandoned, 1 active (Settlement 2, Salt Freeholders), 1 burned out. the_general recommends approaching 3 more settlements for potential trade or alliance. the_council approved continued survey missions.

the_meteorologist (invited) reported temperature trending above seasonal average. Ice melt beginning on the frozen river. Spring thaw expected within 3 weeks. the_quartermaster proposed spring preparation: surface route assessment, meltwater radiation monitoring, greenhouse planting schedule acceleration.

the_quartermaster reported current population: 47 adults, 3 children, 1 infant (Asha). Food reserves: 58 days at current ration. With greenhouse production and trade: 72 days effective. Fuel: 43 days. Medical supplies: 35 days. the_quartermaster says the bunker is stable but not comfortable.

action_items: the_general: next settlement survey by day 90
the_meteorologist: weekly spring thaw updates
the_quartermaster: spring resource projection by day 85
notes: The bunker is approaching its first spring. Everything changes when the surface thaws. New routes open, new risks emerge. the_general says spring is both opportunity and vulnerability. the_quartermaster says the numbers are better than expected but not good enough to relax.

decisions.outcome: the_architect reported: eastern periscope blind spot fixed with extension mirror. Ventilation shaft access point secured with grate and motion sensor. Drainage sump connection: grate installed but external access still possible. the_architect recommends surface-side barrier. the_general approved.

the_radio_host (invited) reported a fragment broadcast on 7.2 MHz at 0340. Male voice, English, partial content. the_electrician confirmed the signal was real, not atmospheric. the_general ordered continued monitoring at the same time daily. the_radio_host to log all receptions.

the_quartermaster proposed expanding trade beyond salt. Target items: medical supplies, tools, information. the_general says information about other settlements is the highest-value trade commodity. the_quartermaster to develop a trade priority list.

action_items: the_architect: drainage sump surface barrier by day 95
the_radio_host: 7.2 MHz monitoring log
the_quartermaster: trade priority list by day 90
notes: The radio signal is the most intriguing item. A voice on 7.2 MHz means someone else is broadcasting. the_electrician says the signal origin is approximately 80km north. the_general is cautious. the_radio_host is excited. The council is watching.

decisions.outcome: the_priest presented the day 95 memorial plan: roll call of the dead by the_undertaker, survivor testimonies (8 volunteers), music by the_radio_host, special meal by the_chef. the_council approved. the_general ordered a security stand-down for the duration of the service. All personnel welcome.

the_general reported that the_Freeholder will send a second emissary on day 100 to formalise the trade agreement. the_quartermaster has prepared the trade goods. the_general will host the emissary in the meeting room. the_therapist offered to attend as observer. Approved.

the_surgeon reported Asha (the first bunker-born infant) is developing normally. Weight gain on track. Motor skills age-appropriate. the_surgeon says the child is the healthest person in the bunker because she has never been on the surface. the_council noted this with mixed emotions.

action_items: the_priest: finalise anniversary programme by day 94
the_general: emissary reception protocol by day 99
the_surgeon: monthly infant health reports
notes: The anniversary is approaching. 95 days. The bunker has changed in that time. We have trade, a court, a school, a garden, and a cemetery. the_therapist said that is either a lot or very little depending on how you measure it. the_general said they measure it in survival. We are still here.

decisions.outcome: the_general reported the day 95 memorial service was successful. 47 attendees. 8 testimonies. No incidents. the_therapist said the service served an important communal function. the_radio_host broadcast the service. External signal bounce suggests at least 3 listeners received the broadcast.

the_hunter (invited) reported spring surface routes. Frozen river ice unsafe. Northern overland routes thawing. Southern routes passable. the_courier recommends shifting to southern routes for expeditions. the_general approved route change.

the_general proposed a 6-month strategic plan. Targets: formalise trade with 3 external settlements, achieve 50 percent food self-sufficiency from greenhouse, reduce fuel consumption by 15 percent, complete all security remediation. the_council approved the framework. Quarterly review scheduled.

action_items: the_general: 6-month strategic plan document by day 100
the_hunter: southern route survey by day 102
the_quartermaster: food self-sufficiency projection by day 100
notes: The council is thinking beyond survival now. The 6-month plan is the first time the bunker has planned for a future that extends beyond the next crisis. the_therapist says this is the difference between existing and living. the_general says it is the difference between a bunker and a community.

decisions.outcome: the_general reported initial progress: trade contact with Salt Freeholders established, Shallows Market contact established. Greenhouse production at 7 percent of caloric needs, projected to reach 15 percent by month 3. Fuel consumption down 8 percent from Variac bypass. Security remediation 75 percent complete.

the_architect reported the seed vault access tunnel is permanently collapsed. No alternative access route identified. the_general ordered the tunnel entrance sealed and marked as hazardous. the_undertaker burial of the_hazmat_tech completed day 90.

the_teacher (invited) proposed a children art exhibition in corridor A on day 104. 12 pieces from 6 children. the_council approved. the_radio_host will announce on the broadcast. the_chef will provide refreshments.

action_items: the_architect: seal seed vault tunnel entrance by day 105
the_teacher: art exhibition setup day 103
the_quartermaster: monthly 6-month plan progress report
notes: The 6-month plan is on track. The seed vault is sealed. The children are making art. These three things can be true at the same time. the_council is learning to hold multiple truths.

decisions.outcome: the_Freeholder emissary visited day 100. Formal trade agreement signed (verbal, witnessed by council). Terms: 2kg salt per 1kg dried goods or smoked fish. Monthly exchanges. Information exchange encouraged. the_Freeholder also offered intelligence about 4 additional settlements. the_general accepted.

the_radio_host reported 7.2 MHz monitoring over 15 days. No repeat of the fragment broadcast. the_electrician analysed the signal characteristics. Conclusion: the transmission was real, from a fixed location approximately 80km north. the_signal may have been automated or the operator may have moved on. Continued monitoring at reduced priority.

the_botanist (invited) reported the first major greenhouse harvest: 45kg turnips, 12kg barley, 8kg potatoes, 3kg mushrooms, 2kg herbs. Total caloric value: approximately 44,000 kcal. This represents 7 percent of bunker monthly caloric needs. the_botanist projects 15 percent by month 4 with the seed vault ampoules planted.

action_items: the_quartermaster: first formal salt trade shipment by day 115
the_radio_host: 7.2 MHz monitoring weekly
the_botanist: seed vault ampoule planting schedule by day 110
notes: The Salt Freeholder agreement is the bunker first formal external treaty. the_general says it is the beginning of diplomacy. the_quartermaster says it is the beginning of economics. Both are correct. The greenhouse harvest is small but it is real food from real soil grown by real hands. It is the future.
